description.ja: ChatGLM2-6Bベースの第2世代コードモデル。600Bコードトークンで追加学習。CodeGeeX比で+107%の性能向上。INT4量子化で6GB VRAMで推論可能。
description.en: Second generation code model based on ChatGLM2-6B. Additional training on 600B code tokens. +107% performance improvement over CodeGeeX. Inference possible with 6GB VRAM using INT4.

description.ja: 標準版。HumanEval-X全言語で大幅性能向上（Python +57%、Rust +321%）。
description.en: Standard version. Significant improvement on HumanEval-X across all languages (Python +57%, Rust +321%).

description.ja: INT4量子化版。6GB VRAMで推論可能。
description.en: INT4 quantized version. Inference possible with 6GB VRAM.
